workspace "Bank Portal" "C4 model of the online banking platform" {

    model {

        customer = person "Bank Customer" "Manages their accounts, moves money, and tracks their activity."

        cardPaymentNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "Card payment network operated by a different organization."
        creditReferenceAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "Credit reference agency operated by a different organization."

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "Online banking platform owned and operated by our company." {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts." "Web"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app." "API"
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records." "Service"
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers." "Service"
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers." "Service"
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards." "Service"
            fraudDetectionService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud." "Service"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts." "Service"
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers." "Service"
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements." "Service"
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits." "Service"
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates." "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation." "Batch"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts." "Queue"
            ledgerDb = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement." "Database"
            customerDb = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records." "Database"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail." "Database"
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data." "Cache"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs." "File Store"

            webPortal -> accountService
            webPortal -> transactionService
            webPortal -> paymentService
            webPortal -> cardService
            webPortal -> statementsService
            webPortal -> directDebitService

            mobileAppBackend -> accountService
            mobileAppBackend -> transactionService
            mobileAppBackend -> paymentService
            mobileAppBackend -> cardService
            mobileAppBackend -> statementsService
            mobileAppBackend -> directDebitService

            paymentService -> cardPaymentNetwork "Routes card authorisations through"
            onboardingService -> creditReferenceAgency "Performs credit checks through"

            transactionService -> ledgerDb "Updates"
            transactionService -> fraudDetectionService "Scores transactions with"
            transactionService -> eventQueue "Publishes events to"

            notificationService -> eventQueue "Consumes events from"

            statementsService -> ledgerDb "Reads"
            statementsService -> documentStore "Writes"

            batchScheduler -> ledgerDb "Reads and writes"
            batchScheduler -> customerDb "Reads and writes"

            cardService -> paymentService "Serves"
            exchangeRatesService -> paymentService "Serves"

            onboardingService -> customerDb "Reads"
        }

        customer -> bankPortal "Uses the platform to manage their accounts, move money, and track their activity"
    }

    views {
        systemContext bankPortal "SystemContext" "System context view of the Bank Portal." {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
        container bankPortal "Containers" "Container view of the Bank Portal." {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
    }
}

workspace "Claims Center" "C4 model of the insurance company's claims platform" {

    model {

        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Uses the platform to report claims and track their progress."

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The claims platform owned and operated by the insurance company." {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress." "Web Application"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app." "Service"
            claimsIntake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims." "Service"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims." "Service"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts." "Service"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements." "Service"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims." "Service"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports." "Service"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders." "Service"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters." "Service"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims." "Web Application"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy." "Service"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners." "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation." "Service"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts." "Queue"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records." "Database"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records." "Database"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail." "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence." "File Store"
        }

        nationalClaimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization." {
            tags "External"
        }
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization." {
            tags "External"
        }

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks their progress"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks their progress via the insurer's mobile app"

        webPortal -> claimsIntake "reaches"
        webPortal -> assessment "reaches"
        webPortal -> payout "reaches"
        webPortal -> documentService "reaches"
        webPortal -> notificationService "reaches"

        mobileAppBackend -> claimsIntake "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "reaches"
        mobileAppBackend -> notificationService "reaches"

        claimsIntake -> triage "hands accepted claims"
        triage -> assessment "routes claims"
        assessment -> payout "requests settlements"

        claimsIntake -> fraudScreening "sends each incoming claim for screening"
        claimsIntake -> policyVerification "requests cover checks"
        assignment -> adjusterWorkbench "routes claims"

        fraudScreening -> nationalClaimsDataBureau "consults"
        payout -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through"

        documentService -> documentStore "reads"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "reads and writes"
        notificationService -> policyholder "reports claim status changes"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "The context of the Claims Center system." {
            include *
        }
        container claimsCenter "Containers" "The application parts of the Claims Center system." {
            include *
        }
    }
}
